page.notes: Text is faint and slightly cut at the bottom of the left and middle columns; the middle column's last lines and the right column's entries near "Libertatis" and "Licentia" are doubtful. Some page numbers are uncertain (e.g. "Libertatis abusus ... 110.b", "Libertas quae lubditis conceditur", "Libri spectandi ... 39.b"). The reference "Legem virex" and "Leges ... ludorum" lines are read with some uncertainty. The last entry of the left column ("Lex contra fraudem in ponderibus") is split across columns with the continuation "bus 125" at the head of the middle column; it is joined here. The "Libertorum perucrfa educatio ao" line is cut off at the foot of the middle column and may continue in print. Greek "Κύριος" is transcribed from the scan.
